body:
> There is some code that uses raw pointers to GameStateSnapshot objects - now that the snapshots are being freed, there's some risk that these pointers could point to already deleted objects.

I feel like we should probably just change `SnapshotView` (and possibly other classes as well) to hold `Ref<GameStateSnapshot>` now instead of raw pointers. I can't really see the harm in it. We can do that in a future PR though.

Besides the minor issue with using `dynamic_cast`, this all looks good to me.
